title: Azores region dedicated packs: surge playbook, legal checklist & release notes coordination
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Prepare and coordinate the launch of Dedicated reservation packs in the Azores region. This ticket covers SKU definitions, surge/SLA playbook, legal and billing checklist, release-note authoring and signoff, cross-team comms, and a staged rollout plan with fallbacks to avoid customer disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted and approved by PM + Legal + Technical Writing
Billing SKUs created in monetization system and validated end-to-end in staging
Legal/compliance checklist completed for EU-like jurisdiction (data residency and export controls)
Telemetry and latency dashboards provisioned in Console for Azores region and smoke-tested with synthetic traffic
Surge playbook (activation steps + rollback) validated in DR runbook and shared with SRE on-call
Partner enablement pack (sales deck, FAQ, pricing table) delivered and scheduled for partner training
tasks: Finalize SKU mapping and price bands for compact/standard/plus packs (PM, Billing)
Create billing product entries and test invoice flows in sandbox (Billing Engineer)
Draft legal checklist: data residency, export review, contract language updates (Legal)
Author release notes: feature summary, limits, known issues, migration notes (PM + Tech Writing)
Create observability dashboard in Console: latency P95/P99, token cost, queue length (Observability eng)
Run DR smoke test: simulate 10% of traffic on Azores region and validate fallback to main EU region (SRE)
Schedule partner enablement webinar and record training materials (GTM)
Publish runbook and escalation matrix to Confluence and link in on-call rotations (SRE)
notes: 2026-02-12: Initial scoping meeting with SRE, Billing, Legal. Agreed to treat Azores as EU-equivalent for data residency and breach notification timelines.
2026-02-15: Decided to release with three reservation pack SKUs (compact/standard/plus) to simplify price anchoring for SMBs. Trade-off: fewer granular tiers vs simpler go-to-market.
2026-02-22: Eng risk review - ENG-19872 will deliver instance family mapping; if delayed, plan B is to offer G7x family only for GA and add more families in a follow-up patch.
2026-02-28: Legal requested an extra clause for export controls; Legal PR created: https://github.com/redwood/legal/pull/213
2026-03-03: Billing sandbox test showed invoice rounding edge-case for quarterly billing. Billing eng created fix PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/1245
2026-03-06: Release notes draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/folders/azores-launch-release-notes-draft
2026-03-10: Cross-functional readiness sync scheduled for 2026-03-15. Current status: legal in review, billing UAT failing edge-case (in progress), telemetry smoke test scheduled for 2026-03-12.
launch_checklist: Legal checklist signed-off and doc stored in Confluence
Billing SKUs live in sandbox and validated
Release notes approved and staged for publish
On-call runbook published and pager rotations updated
Partner enablement session scheduled and materials uploaded
Rollout phasing plan: GA -> limited beta (selected customers) -> full GA
Fallback policy: automatic routing to eu-central-1 with capacity reservation for 48 hours
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Billing edge cases could delay GA. Mitigation: ship GA in limited beta with manual billing verification for first 48 hours.
Risk: Kernel/instance mapping delays. Mitigation: allow single instance family for GA and expand families post-GA with a clear compatibility matrix.
Risk: Unexpected latency spike in Azores due to peering. Mitigation: pre-warm routes, enable automatic fallback, and publish clear SLA exceptions in release notes.
next_steps: Finalize legal clause updates and obtain sign-off by 2026-03-12
Resolve billing UAT and merge billing PRs by 2026-03-14
Complete telemetry smoke tests and mark dashboard green by 2026-03-12
Run an internal dry-run of the surge playbook with SRE on 2026-03-16
Prepare final release notes and schedule publish window for 2026-03-20
